question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Middlemarch, Bob gets Emma, and Claire gets Ivanhoe.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Bob swap books. Then, Bob and Claire swap books. Finally, Bob and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Middlemarch
(B) Emma
(C) Ivanhoe
solution:
Each row lists books in order: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: Middlemarch | Emma | Ivanhoe
1. Alice swaps with Bob: Emma | Middlemarch | Ivanhoe
2. Bob swaps with Claire: Emma | Ivanhoe | Middlemarch
3. Bob swaps with Alice: Ivanhoe | Emma | Middlemarch
Bob has Emma, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
